correct_query: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM Regions r JOIN Countries c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN Locations l ON c.country_id = l.country_id JOIN Customers cu ON l.location_id = cu.location_id JOIN Orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN OrderItems oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE cu.credit_limit > 1000 AND p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING total_sales > 50000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 3;

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mismatch in aggregate and window functions logic (used ROW_NUMBER instead of LIMIT with ORDER BY properly)
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) as rn FROM Regions r JOIN Countries c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN Locations l ON c.country_id = l.country_id JOIN Customers cu ON l.location_id = cu.location_id JOIN Orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN OrderItems oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE cu.credit_limit > 1000 AND p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING total_sales > 50000) WHERE rn <= 3;
